query: SELECT 'منطقة الرياض' AS region, hp.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS population FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = true AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND Trim( hl.region ) = 'منطقة الرياض' GROUP BY hp.gender ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 1200
